title: Common upper stage for finitely many equalities
statement: Let I be a nonempty directed preorder and F a diagram of commutative rings with colimit [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Fix i and a finite type T. For each t let M_t,N_t be F(i)-modules and f_t,g_t maps. If for each t their scalar extensions agree at some j_t above i, they all agree after extension to a single stage above i. No finite-presentation hypothesis is needed.

proof.text: Induct over the finite set of indices, starting at i for the empty family. For an insertion, obtain one witness stage for the new pair and the previous common stage; directedness supplies a bound of these two stages.

Apply scalar extension to each earlier equality. Naturality of Mathlib ModuleCat.extendScalarsComp, conjugated by its component isomorphisms, identifies equality of iterated extensions with equality of direct extensions; F.map_comp identifies the composite ring maps.

theorem exists_common_stage_of_stage_equalities
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (F : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) [HasColimit F]
    (i : I) {T : Type v} [Finite T]
    (M N : T → ModuleCat.{u} (F.obj i))
    (f g : ∀ t, M t ⟶ N t)
    (h : ∀ t, ∃ (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j),
      (extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE hij)).hom).map (f t) =
        (extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE hij)).hom).map (g t)) :
    ∃ (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j), ∀ t,
      (extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE hij)).hom).map (f t) =
        (extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE hij)).hom).map (g t)
